name: Wu Yuheng
bio:
Wu Yuheng, also known as Christopher Wu, was born on September 11, 1996, in Chengdu, Sichuan, China. He is a Chinese actor and singer. Wu Yuheng gained recognition through his participation in the music talent show The Coming One 2 in 2018, where he showcased his musical abilities. In 2021, he further rose to prominence as a contestant on the survival show Chuang 2021.

He has appeared in various TV dramas, including Moments of Youth (2024), Mr. Insomnia Waiting for Love (2023), and The Blessed Girl (2021).
